Cinematic editorial photograph: an adult fictional woman whose general appearance follows the attached portrait: long center-parted dark wavy hair, brown eyes, a softly oval facial outline, natural brows, and calm focused poise. Image 1 supplies only those broad cues to a distinct adult fictional person. In a rain-lashed orbital ferry terminal at night, she rotates a sculptural oxblood-and-black leather diplomatic case toward press cameras during launch countdown. The case carries a large original non-letter emblem formed from an asymmetrical crescent and stepped hexagon. Present it as an original fictional non-letter emblem and a large central emblem with high visual prominence. The same motif repeats across surface and hardware at a coordinated motif scale. Show the emblem integrated into construction through deep leather embossing, a motif aligned with seams and fasteners, reinforced edges, and a distinctive brushed-metal latch. Frame a three-quarter full figure with the detailed case dominating the foreground; use a low three-quarter camera, leather grain, wet brutalist concrete, blue launch light, and warm reflected metal. Blank label plates and abstract geometric symbols make the object clearly fictional and brand-neutral.
Avoid: fake-looking background, 3D render look, unrealistic hands, distorted fingers, body distortion, low resolution, over-processed retouching, plastic-looking skin, illustration look
